name: armis-knowledge-stage
description: STAGE environment (knowledge-mcp.moose-stg.armis.com). Adds /knowledge-stage, /cwe-fix-stage, /framework-guidance-stage, and /tech-guidance-stage commands. Reads ARMIS_CLIENT_ID, ARMIS_CLIENT_SECRET, and ARMIS_TENANT_SLUG; exchanges them for a short-lived JWT on startup. Tenant isolation enforced server-side; no knowledge data stored on disk.
